security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-src http://127.0.0.1:*; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Words into a song — bring your own ACE-Step server
bundle.longDescription: Paste lyrics or describe a topic, choose a genre and a length, and get a song from your own ACE-Step server. No account, no telemetry; audio is saved locally.
